about: Event of esv::dialog::PrivacySystem (ProcessFailedJoinAttempts): a character tried to listen in on a private dialog. The client sends it with ecl::LSDialogsProtocol::SendFailedJoinDialog(unsigned int const& dialogId, Guid const& listener, Guid const& speaker) (EoCClient.dll+0xECF160, called from CharacterTask_Listen with the listening character's UUID first and the speaker's second); the server keeps a HashMap<dialog id, set of 32-byte (Guid, Guid) records> and turns every record into one event entity with this component (game bg3.exe+0x2E1C020). Registered as a normal component although named OneFrame. Never seen alive. Registry total 40 (server row).

evidence.says: Creator bg3.exe+0x2E1CC60 (AllocRaw 0x28) zeroes the dword at +0; writer bg3.exe+0x2E1C020 line 153 `*puVar9 = *puVar14` - the 4-byte key of the system's HashMap (the dialog instance id, first parameter of SendFailedJoinDialog).
padding before the 8-aligned Guid; never written.

Creator zeroes +8/+0x10; writer lines 154-158 copy the first 16 bytes of the 32-byte record to +8. By the order of SendFailedJoinDialog's arguments (EoCClient.dll+0x114A820 passes the listening character's UUID first), the character that tried to join.

Creator zeroes +0x18/+0x20; writer lines 159-165 copy the record's second 16 bytes to +0x18 (dwords puVar9[6..9]). Second Guid of SendFailedJoinDialog = the speaker entity's UUID ('no speaker entity' assert).
